exposure: Pregnancies with younger paternal and older maternal age
Paternal age groups (<30 years, 30-34.9 years, 35-39.9 years, 40-44.9 years, ≥45 years)
cohort: 16,114 singleton deliveries in China from 2016 to 2021
finding: Older paternal age was independently associated with increased risks of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), cesarean delivery, preterm birth, and macrosomia, even after adjusting for potential confounders.
mod_finding: While older paternal age alone was not significantly associated with most adverse perinatal outcomes after adjustments, the risk of cesarean delivery was higher for older fathers.
